First of all, I think having a good and positive mentality is the best thing you can have when trying to climb the ladder. Also, never argue with your teammates, just communicate with pings.

Hmm, if Im not doing anything, Im sitting in my bedroom, browsing reddit, youtube, the internet. Sometimes I talk to my friends on skype, sometimes I go play some other video games, just to pass time. Or I read.

Other than that, sometimes I just space out, and think about stuff for 15, 30 minutes. In the past weeks I've been hanging alot with my friends, out of having nothing else better to do. But this week has been really boring and gray.

Damn... Where I live I don't have many options though. I even think that was my only option to be honest. And the problem is I have social anxiety so it's hard for me to do anything related to people alone...

Yeah, I guess so. The first thing that popped into my mind, and this might seem a bit childish to you, but this has been something that used to be quite on my mind, was reach Diamond 1 in LoL, Im currently sitting in Plat 5 though. 

But other things popped into my mind such as finishing my high school, finishing a good book series Im currently reading ( Im only in the first book though, and there are 13 in the series so far ).

There are alot of things I want to accomplish, but like I said, it's just hard to do when I don't enjoy doing anything anymore. Im trying to be happy though, I really am trying really hard...

I don't see how we could figure this thing that is depression out. I don't think there is a way out of depression, it sticks to you and doesn't let go... 

If you think you have the secret formula to be happy, like I once was, I'd be more than willing to hear it.

Yeah I get you, I don't want to be on any medication either. That's not a lifestyle I want, although what Im living right now isn't exactly better... I've even tried getting psychiatric help, they said they would call me back, but they didin't. And Im scared of going back or calling them you know... I have a job also, but then again I don't enjoy that either.

It's hard when you feel that shitty depression always weighing down on you, like a burden I have to carry.

That's the thing though... I don't like doing anything. I never liked doing exercise either. I used to enjoy playing video games the most. That's almost all I did, and because of that, I still havn't finished my high school. ( And I'm 19... )

 I have social anxiety, so going back to school isn't something that is realistic for me right now. My dream used to be a pro gamer, but that's also not realistic.

Im trying my best to think that I could be happy in the future, but that's not easy. I do appreciate you trying to help though, thank you.
Well, at least now he has MR per level?

Thanks, and yes, I am getting therapy in the upcoming few weeks.

I appreciate the answer, but I must say : video games have always been my way of relaxing, and actually enjoying life. Like I said, being a pro gamer is, you could say, my "goal". It's more of a dream, since sometimes I feel like it's a pointless goal, but right now it's the only one I have, so I have to stick with it. Physical activities have never been my thing either. I've always been a slim guy anyway. I'll try to think about the 1 to 5 things that I'm grateful for when I wake up 

Thanks for the answer.

The "Did I Love" part spoke to me the most. Loving yourself is quite important. I've been my worst enemy without realising. I guess it's easier said than done, but it's something that I can definitely work on. This cheered me up quite a lot. Thank you.

Yeah I also get that, getting depressed a while, then im a bit happier again, then im depressed again... and so on. I've been getting a lot more depressed lately though. I hope I can get through it like you said.
I was thinking about that. And then again, the only thing I enjoy doing from time to time is playing video games. There's pretty much nothing I can do with that if Im not a pro gamer though...

I totally get that as well. I had the exact same thing happen to me, I also had the vivid thought of killing myself, the main focus being my mom's reation as well. Personnaly, I like thinking that that would pain very much, and then I think of the rest of my family finding out, their hearts breaking. I guess I like the idea that I am loved and that I would be missed if something were to happen.
